title: dupatya sellowiana
intro: Dupatya sellowiana, commonly known as Maytenus boaria or Liriosma ovata, is a plant species in the family Icacinaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The plant has been found to possess therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds. The bioactive constituents in Dupatya sellowiana have been reported to have potential health benefits, including cardiovascular protection, neuroprotection, and anti-cancer activities.
